turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Rachel Tan. Daniel Lee speaking. We have our scheduled discussion today. Before we begin, may I take your identification details and date of birth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Daniel. My identification number is G six three one five four nine five K. My date of birth is 20 June 1979. I'd appreciate keeping the discussion concise. I'm fitting this in between calls at the distribution business.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. I'll keep the discussion focused. Your investment objective is long-term capital growth through diversified exposure, without relying solely on equity markets. That is the objective I have recorded for this discussion. I recommend Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund because its combination of equity and fixed-income exposure supports your aim of long-term growth without relying solely on equities. Its managed allocation also means you do not have to manage the asset-class mix yourself.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like to hear the remaining points before we get to the paperwork.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, rising interest rates can reduce the value of its fixed-income holdings. Its equity and fixed-income holdings can also fall together during market stress, limiting the protection diversification provides. Do you understand how rising interest rates can affect the fund's fixed-income holdings, and that its equity and fixed-income holdings can fall together?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand those risks. Rising rates can reduce the value of the fixed-income holdings, and diversification does not prevent the equity and fixed-income holdings from falling together.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. Your capital is not protected in this investment. You could lose some or all of the money you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your long-term growth objective?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses in pursuing long-term growth.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For future portfolio updates, would you prefer a short written summary ahead of our discussions? That could help keep the calls focused without making the correspondence cumbersome.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A short summary would be useful. I'm planning a quieter work schedule as the family takes on more of the daily operations. I'd rather not spend that time working through lengthy emails.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that correspondence preference. We can keep routine administration separate from the main discussion, so it's easier to find what needs your attention.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The product I want to invest in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to buy the units. Please use renminbi as the transaction currency. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 1m. Please set the quantity at 2,000 units. Please place a limit order with a price limit of 500 Chinese yuan per unit. I usually view portfolio comparisons in American dollars. How would that reporting view relate to this purchase, without changing the transaction currency?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: A reporting view is a presentation setting, separate from the dealing instruction. We can address how the statement is displayed as an administrative matter. Let me check the entry now. I have your selected product as Summit Global Equity ETF. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, that is not the product I selected. My instruction is for Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I apologise for the incorrect readback. With the product corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 2,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, for an amount of 1m in renminbi, using a limit order with a price limit of 500 Chinese yuan per unit.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I explicitly confirm that final instruction as you have just stated it, with the corrected product. Please place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. That concludes our discussion. I'll also note your preference for concise written updates.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. I need to get back to the office calls now. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
